target: forge.sh pr-create — API or gh failure exits non-zero, explains on stderr, and prints nothing on stdout
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
L="GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests?source_branch=feat&state=opened"
P="POST /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests"
pc() { fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show "$1"; }
fx_http "$L" 200 '[]'
fx_http "$P" 500 '{"message":"boom"}'; pc http500
echo "posts500=$(fx_nmeth POST)"
fx_http "$P" 400 '{"message":"bad"}'; pc http400
fx_http "$L" transport-error; pc transport
fx_setremote https://github.com/o/r.git
fx_gh pr_list 0 ''; fx_gh pr_create 1 'gh-said-boom'; pc gh
fx_done
